test.create_query: CREATE TABLE array_distinct_decimal (decimal32_duplicates Array(Decimal32(2)), decimal64_duplicates Array(Decimal64(4)), decimal128_duplicates Array(Decimal128(8)), decimal256_duplicates Array(Decimal256(12)), decimal64_unique Array(Decimal64(4)), decimal64_all_equal Array(Decimal64(4)), decimal64_nullable Array(Nullable(Decimal64(4))), numeric Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO array_distinct_decimal SELECT arrayMap(i -> toDecimal32(intDiv(i, 4) + number % 17, 2), range(128)), arrayMap(i -> toDecimal64(intDiv(i, 4) + number % 17, 4), range(128)), arrayMap(i -> toDecimal128(intDiv(i, 4) + number % 17, 8), range(128)), arrayMap(i -> toDecimal256(intDiv(i, 4) + number % 17, 12), range(128)), arrayMap(i -> toDecimal64(i + number % 17, 4), range(128)), arrayMap(i -> toDecimal64(number % 17, 4), range(128)), arrayMap(i -> if(i % 2 = 0, CAST(NULL, 'Nullable(Decimal64(4))'), toDecimal64(intDiv(i, 4) + number % 17, 4)), range(128)), arrayMap(i -> intDiv(i, 4) + number % 17, range(128)) FROM numbers(50000)
test.query: SELECT sum(length(arrayDistinct(numeric))) FROM array_distinct_decimal FORMAT Null
